Each era of the revolution and struggle demands the might of ideology peculiar and suited to it.
Today's ideological campaign should be an innovative, creative and offensive one leading the times.
It is easy to follow the old ones, but this is very dangerous. Whereas, it is difficult to create new ones suitable for today, but this is very necessary.

We must not forget that many well-known and unknown information workers active in the annals of our revolution had devoted much wisdom and efforts to fulfilling their revolutionary duty assigned by their eras and, consequently, the precious ideological wealth of our revolution and the tradition of ideological work were provided.

When you actively explore and apply new, novel and effective means and methods of information work that meet the requirements of the Party, the times and the reality, our ideological position will become stronger with the rapid advance of our times.

Therefore, all the participants should have a correct understanding of the importance and significance of the current workshop and devote themselves to acquiring the essence, the knack and matured methodology of ideological work in line with the intention of the Party Central Committee, thus making the period of the workshop a useful and meaningful occasion.

Expressing once again the stand of the Party Central Committee that attaches greater importance and expectation in the current workshop, which will serve as a milestone of epochal turn to register another clear page in our Party's history of ideological work, than any other sectional conference or workshop, Comrade Kim Jong Un declared the opening of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea.

The participants in the workshop responded with enthusiastic cheers and applause to the revolutionary stand of Comrade Kim Jong Un who manifested his will to firmly consolidate the precious tradition of the Korean revolution, which was pioneered and has emerged victorious with ideology, as the mainstay for the eternal victory of our cause.
The national anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was played.
Choe Chang Hak, first vice director of the Information and Publicity Department of the C.C., WPK, made a report.

The reporter said that the past two years since the Second Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the WPK were a sacred revolutionary journey, in which the political and ideological position of the DPRK was further consolidated despite manifold trials and adversity under the outstanding guidance of Comrade General Secretary Kim Jong Un and the leadership and invincibility of our Party dynamically ushering in a new era of comprehensive development by dint of ideology were fully demonstrated.

He noted that the General Secretary attached greater importance to the Party ideological work as socialist construction expanded day by day and the advance speed of the revolution accelerated and indicated the important guidelines for increasing the might of ideology and the effectiveness of ideological work to the maximum.

While energetically guiding the ideological work of the Party to make it a fresh and effective political work process suited to the requirements of the times and the developing revolution and our national status and prestige with clear purpose and aim, the General Secretary clarified ideas and theories which serve as precious treasures for further enriching the treasure house of ideological building of the WPK for their profundity and scientific accuracy, the reporter stressed.

The reporter recalled that the General Secretary put forth the ideological work as the main focus of the Party work and set a great model and precious example of solving all the problems through political work of enlisting the might of ideology in the course of the struggle to usher in a period of comprehensive development for national rejuvenation.

The recent trend of change witnessed in the field of ideological work, in which brisk activities are being launched to constantly explore and apply new forms and methods in conformity with the people's mentalities, is attributable to the energetic leadership of the General Secretary who indicated concrete methodology for information and motivation work to the details, he said.

The report stressed the importance and urgency of innovation in the ideological work being further highlighted in the present struggle to consolidate the successes made in the course of opening up the era of comprehensive development and lead them to a greater result.

Saying that the Party information sector is faced with the important revolutionary task for modeling the whole Party and society on the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee and giving full play to the inexhaustible ideological and mental strength of all the people in the struggle to attain the new long-term goals set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Party, the reporter referred to the principled issues for more thoroughly preparing the officials in the Party information sector as faithful spokespersons of the Party Central Committee and the revolution.

The present era calls the masters of the ideological campaign, who have acquired the Juche-oriented theory of giving importance to ideology as their mental qualities, to the forefront of the struggle, the reporter said, calling for deeply grasping the great revolutionary ideas and leadership mode of Comrade Kim Jong Un and his noble outlook on the people and thoroughly applying them to the Party ideological work and thus making great innovations and leaps forward in information and motivation work and more vigorously and dynamically opening up a new era of strengthening the whole Party and rejuvenating the whole state.
Ri Il Hwan appeared in the first lecture.

All the participants, who received the warm encouragement and expectation of Comrade General Secretary Kim Jong Un in boundless excitement, are taking part in the workshop with high political awareness and enthusiasm. -0-

43471f3e8d3913afbf81811967e5fbdf.title: DPRK Missile Administration Tests New, Important Combat Weapon System
paragraphs: Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea successfully tested a new-type weapon, which is of great significance in the rapid technological development of weapon systems, on September 20.
The test did not have any adverse impact on the security of neighboring countries.
It is an extension of the regular activities of the DPRK Missile Administration and its defence science research institutes aimed at implementing the national defence policy.
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the test.

Saying that the test was undoubtedly a striking demonstration of ultra-modern defence technology and clear progress in the modernization of the armed forces, he stressed that it represents the irresistible might.

To acquire such a technology is of weighty significance in the state's readiness for war and the future development of the armed forces, he said, adding that the enemy will know better what such progress means without any explanation in the aspect of military technology. He affirmed that such reality would give the enemy an incurable headache and a very cruel and unavoidable blow.

Today's success is the priceless fruit brought by a special think tank of the sci-tech forces involved in development of the important weapon system for a specific purpose and their sincere efforts, he said, expressing thanks to the Missile Administration and its defence science institutes and working groups. -0-

7a5acc880a443f102a96efe2df875559.title: Third Workshop for Officials in Information Sector of WPK Closes
paragraphs: Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea, which has added another brilliant page to the history of ideological work of the WPK, closed on September 21 after successfully concluding its scheduled work.
Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, attended the closing ceremony and made an important speech.

When he took the platform together with accompanying officials, all the audiences broke into enthusiastic cheers in reverence for Comrade General Secretary Kim Jong Un who organized the workshop in the crucial historic period of deciding the brilliant success and future of our cause and is working thoughtfully and painstakingly to make it an occasion of a radical turn in consolidating the politico-ideological might, the greatest national power of the DPRK, in every way.

In his speech, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that the workshop was successfully held in conformity with the desired purpose of making it a major process for innovating ideological work, whereby all the officials in the information sector of the Party have a full understanding of the Party's immutable ideology-first principle and their sense of duty to innovate the ideological work.

Saying that the officials in the information sector of the Party have hardened in a fresh manner their sacred revolutionary awareness and sense of heavy responsibility to increase our ideological resources a hundred times and consolidate the guarantee for carrying forward our cause, he referred to the fundamental principle the officials should always keep in mind as communists and to the absolute viability of the Juche-based theory of giving importance to ideology. And he clarified the firm stand of the Party Central Committee to realize our ideal without fail in the future dynamic struggle on the strength of the great revolutionary ideology, the greatest asset of the Party, and the might of the information and motivation work peculiar to the Party which turns the ideology into the might of transformation.

Comrade Kim Jong Un set forth the principled issues, to be adhered to in putting the contents, forms, methods and means of ideological work on the basis of progress and development in line with the expectations of the times, the revolution and the people waiting eagerly for fresh changes and innovations in information and motivation work and creation of cultures that will encourage and further diversify our struggle and life, and the important tasks and ways for ensuring the innovation in the ideological work of the whole Party.

He declared the workshop closed, stressing that a series of greater successes and innovations would be witnessed in our struggle for bringing earlier the great ideal and bright future with the irresistible might of ideology, he expressed the belief that all the participants would dynamically pave the avenue for advance in the new era with the zeal and courage befitting the ideological guards of the WPK under the uplifted banner of the ideology-first principle.

All the participants responded with stormy cheers and rapturous applause to his speech adding glory to their high honor as information workers of the ever-victorious WPK, which regards ideology as the most important weapon and guides the revolution by dint of ideology, and further hardening their sense of duty for the times and redoubling their revolutionary zeal.

They loudly sang in chorus the song "Long live the Workers' Party of Korea", in reflection of their faith and pledge to fulfill their duty as ideological guards in steadily writing textbooks on the ideological revolution, to be recorded in our Party history and handed down forever along with our era of transformation, by successfully carrying forward and developing the sacred history and tradition of our Party which pioneered a new era of Juche by rousing the people to the revolution on the strength of ideology.

The venue was filled with revolutionary enthusiasm of all the participants to further consolidate our political and ideological position and dynamically carry forward the upsurge in the overall development of socialism through a powerful ideological offensive, holding aloft the red Party flag of Juche.

The four-day workshop was held amid the extraordinary political consciousness and enthusiasm of all the participants to take the lead in the vigorous campaign for bringing about a radical change in ideological work and qualitatively strengthening the ideological position, an indispensable guarantee and key requirement for the steady succession to the cause of the WPK, with their fresh determination, redoubled efforts, mature qualifications and positive cultivation of traits.

There was an intensive study for deeply grasping the essence of the important speech made by Comrade Kim Jong Un at the opening ceremony of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the WPK.

Studying in depth the important document, which comprehensively deals with the precious guidelines for further developing the ideological resources, accumulated by our Party for a long time, the extraordinary potentials peculiar to the Korean revolution, at the level required by a new era, an era of comprehensive development when we have entered a new phase in the spheres of our struggle and in all our activities, all the participants hardened their revolutionary will to carry out without fail the policy of the Party Central Committee expecting positive changes in ideological work of the Party, which are stronger than the trend of the changing times and offensive-oriented in surpassing reality.
The workshop was held amid their high awareness that the success of ideological work depends on the qualifications and ability of them taking full charge of the ideological and information work.

Senior officials of the Information and Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the WPK and educational workers of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK gave lectures at the workshop.

First, there was a lecture on concentrating all efforts of the ideological work of the Party on preparing all members of society as true loyalists and ardent patriots armed with the revolutionary ideas of great Comrade Kim Jong Un as their faith.

The lecturer theoretically explained that Comrade Kim Jong Un's revolutionary ideas are the guidelines of our Party and state in the new era and an encyclopedic action program for the revolution and construction as they comprehensively deal with the path and the strategy for carrying forward and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche generation after generation under the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.

The lecture referred to the detailed issues for improving the effectiveness of the ideological and political work by further enhancing the sense of obligation and responsibility of the officials in the information sector of the Party in the struggle for modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary ideology of great Comrade Kim Jong Un.

Then the workshop dealt with the issue of successfully conducting the education in the revolutionary relics and the leadership exploits of the Party, regarding it as the key point of ideological education.

The lecturer explained the methodological ways for further enhancing the cognitional and educational effect in education through the revolutionary relics and the leadership exploits of the Party, the root and starting point of the ideological work of the Party, and intensifying it in a substantial way on the principle of historicism and scientific accuracy.
There was a lecture on stepping up the information and publicity offensive to rouse the masses to implementation of the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.

Through the lecture, the participants kept deep in their minds the orientation of information and agitation work and all principled issues arising in making sure that the working spirit and traits, displayed in pioneering the era of comprehensive development, and the trend of gigantic changes prevailing in all sectors of socialist construction result in steady upsurge, and in properly setting the focus of ideological work in conformity with the specific conditions of every sector and unit to wage an intensive campaign for joint and collective innovations.

The workshop also dealt with the issue of studying fresh forms and methods of ideological work and conducting information work in a realistic and appealing manner and the issue of conducting motivation and agitation with visual aids as required by the Party's policy to maximize their effectiveness.

The lecturers explained the principled and theoretical issues, including the one of exploring and applying new forms and methods of ideological work while studying the Party's policies, the situation and the undertakings from an enterprising and positive standpoint, the one of thoroughly ensuring the politico-ideological characters, timeliness, visualization and culture in displaying political visual aids and preparing the information workers to be the ideological standard-bearers of our Party possessed of high political and professional qualifications and noble humanity.

The participants watched videos dealing with the successes, experience and lessons recently gained and drawn by information units at different levels and there was a question-and-answer session on the practical issues arising in the Party's ideological work.

While deeply studying the contents of the lectures during the workshop in organic correlation with the immediate practical requirements and the prospective requirements of the revolution, they focused their thinking and research on broadly acquiring the essence, exquisite principle and mature methodology of ideological work.

They actively exchanged and shared the good views and experience that would help acquire the innovative work style and manner of always aspiring after new things and development as a habit and ensure the purposeful and meticulous nature of ideological work under a good plan.
A letter of pledge to Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted with fervent applause of the participants.

The Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea, held under the guidance of Comrade Kim Jong Un, marked a significant occasion in further strengthening the Party and the revolutionary ranks into a fortress of single-minded unity and an ideologically pure entity and reliably guaranteeing the steady advance and succession of our cause by boosting the might of the Juche-based theory of attaching importance to ideology in the course of opening up a new era and a new sphere of struggle. -0-

ffdd39971adcf94c7d8524d8ed8d3cba.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Important Speech at Closing Ceremony of Third Workshop for Officials in Information Sector of WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an important speech at the closing ceremony of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the WPK on September 21.
He said in the speech:
Comrades,
I think that this workshop has been conducted well in keeping with the intended purpose of making it an important occasion for bringing about an innovation in the ideological work.

First, you must have acquired a full understanding of our Party's immutable ideology-first principle, the common aspiration to a new level of ideological work demanded by the times and its indispensability.

While attending the opening ceremony of the workshop and receiving the report on its daily course, I could feel the high degree of determination and passion of the participants who, with a unanimous awareness of the compelling mission of the times to transform the ideological work, have maintained self-consciousness and attitude to learn even one more thing.
Such attitude of yours has made me, General Secretary, quite pleased.
I could reaffirm that the information workers are surely higher in political awareness, more sensitive and more enthusiastic than the officials in other sectors.

I am convinced that as the ranks of information workers are so prepared ideologically and so exalted spiritually, I can expect more vigorous efforts and substantial changes in the strengthening of the ideological front, the ideological work, from now on.

You must not have learned all the contents of the practical information work in the few days of the workshop, and you will have to promote development while continuing to learn during your practical work. But I think this workshop must have been an important occasion for renewing your sacred revolutionary consciousness and sense of heavy responsibility that we should increase our ideological resources and consolidate the guarantee of succession to our cause.
This is important, I think.
What matters is how we apply this into practice from now on.

More important and valuable than countless oral determinations are propagation of truth that, even though once, raises and develops the consciousness of the masses and the high-pitched motivation work that inspires them with enthusiasm and courage.
Today, before the closing of the workshop, I would like to stress some more points for the information workers, the core frontline workers of our Party.
Comrades,
We need to be always aware of what we should be like as communists.
That is the Juche-oriented theory of ideology that should never change even though everything else in the world may change, and we are thoroughgoing advocates of the ideology-first principle.
Anything else cannot display the strength of the revolutionary ideology as much, nor can it overwhelm the strength.

We are now absolutely confident in our future because we have ideological assets that we have accumulated in the long course of the revolutionary struggle and that will display their inexhaustible might in the future, too.

The biggest asset of our Party is the great revolutionary ideology as well as the powerful forces for the information and motivation work that can turn the ideology into strength for transformation, and the ever-victorious leadership ability of our Party is just based on the strength of its peculiar information and motivation work.
We should prove this in the proud history of perfectly implementing what we aspire to and what we are going to achieve.

As we all experience, the struggle tasks we are faced with are not a representation of the goals we set in the past decades, but their striking development as well as another transformation in the dynamic course of our revolution.
As long as we have shaped the course and assumed the heavy tasks for ourselves, we must carry them out by our own efforts.

What are essential and urgent in the new struggle course are not any material foundations but the patriotic enthusiasm and extraordinary courage of all officials, Party members and other citizens and the strength of ideological motivation capable of amplifying the enthusiasm and courage for pioneering and creation.

Now is the time for all the people, ranging from leading officials to the citizens living in tips of this country, to stake their destiny and future on the development of the state, orient their wisdom and enthusiasm to the goals of a new stage, and overcome all challenges and obstacles with their indomitable fighting spirit and proactive creative initiative.

Being overpowered by objective factors and adapting to them is something that is alien to us, Korean revolutionaries. We should consistently maintain our unique principle of shaping our future and winning opportunities on the strength of the ideology-first principle whereby we synthesize all the people's great spiritual potentials and patriotic exertion in a concentrated way and bring them into full play.

We should harden our revolutionary stand to realize our ideals without fail by holding higher the banner of ideological oneness, which others cannot hold up even if they want to, namely, the philosophy based on the ideological theory that only our Party can advance in making the revolution with a great people.
Comrades,

After this workshop is over, the masses of Party members and other people will certainly focus their attention on our information workers' attitude and style of work, closely watching their future activities.

As a matter of fact, our people are now looking forward to new changes and innovations in the information and motivational work and cultural creation, which will inspire them in their struggle and enrich their life.
The tasks facing the Party's information sector are much heavier than they were in the past, and accordingly, the Party, the revolution and the times demand a great deal from its information workers.

The wider the area of our advance becomes and the faster we move forward, the greater challenges and difficulties we will inevitably face, Comrade Kim Jong Un said, stressing that responsible and sincere thinking and efforts are required to overcome one bottleneck after another.
He continued:
Our Party's information work should be improved remarkably and it should be more skilful, profound and effective than ever before.
This can be called a challenge for our information workers to overcome, or a big mountain for them to scale.

They should resolutely overcome this challenge with a renewed sense of their mission and through strenuous exertion, thus making sure that this workshop is recorded in our Party's history as a significant milestone in bringing about innovations and improvement in its overall ideological work.
We should, first of all, develop and enrich the contents of ideological education in keeping with the requirements and characteristics of the new era.
The might of ideological work is determined by its contents, and the development of its contents demands improvement of its forms, methods and means.

Sticking to the conventional contents and materials in disregard of the rapid and diversifying changes in the present era or repeating stereotyped logics and arguments cannot be called otherwise than an anachronistic error.

We keep setting ourselves greater ideals and goals in the economy, national defence, culture and all other realms of social life, which we translate into reality at a rapid pace, and our people are witnessing substantial changes in their living environment. Such being the case, the contents of our Party's ideological work should be composed and enriched in an innovative fashion.

By this I never mean that we should reject or reform the traditional contents of our ideological education, but that we should develop them in depth as required by the cause of the advancing revolution.
Therefore, achieving new innovations and a radical improvement in the information and education work should naturally begin with an in-depth development of the contents of the ideological education.
After referring to the importance of conducting the information and education work in a logical and realistic way, Comrade Kim Jong Un went on:

In ensuring that all the people cherish our truthful and advantageous ideology and policies as an element of their unshakeable faith, and in making our ideology and policies serve as a source of their great strength with which to brave difficulties and trials, no method is better than giving them a clear theoretical understanding of the justice of their cause and the inevitability of its victory.

If we adopt a schematic and cramming approach towards the information work, regardless of the principles of things and phenomena and the laws of life and cognition, the truth may be perverted or distorted, and this will finally evoke suspicion and denial.
It is beyond dispute that the ideological education should be not only logical but also down-to-earth.
Truth has an absolute power that defies description by any flowery language.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said that if there were ten or one hundred prescriptions for educating people in the past era, there should be one thousand or ten thousand prescriptions in the present era, and went on:
To base oneself on the concrete living conditions and environment of the people and their psychology is just to base oneself on the reality.

You, information workers, should prepare a lecture plan while always delving into people's inner thoughts and feelings and putting yourselves in their place, and give them an explanation in a way that you can build rapport with them through it and it can result in a substantial change in their cognition.
The forms and means of our information and education work should also steadily be updated in keeping with the development of the times.
The originality and influence of the ideological education work also depend largely on its forms and means, as well as its contents and methods.

As the saying goes, clothing makes the man. Even if it is a good material for information and education, it can neither draw the interest and attention of the masses nor have influence on their thoughts and feelings without the help of new forms and means.
People reject even the right words, if the method is trite. This is human psychology.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said it is a lesson of history that an ideology can either be a source of inexhaustible strength for victory and success or be a terrible toxin for frustration and failure, according to how much a party and a state that are building socialism attach importance to ideological work and how they conduct it, and continued:

If we do not pay attention to ideological education and arming of people with a spirit and to making constant innovations in this regard, while praising ourselves over the modern buildings rising up and the appearance of the country undergoing changes, it will be as good as building a castle on sand by depleting the foremost resources of the state.

The advance of the times is the flow of people's struggle and life and, therefore, in order to apply the character of the times to the ideological work, we should make an in-depth study of the people of today and explore and apply new forms, means and methods to suit them.

The information sector should concentrate the thinking and study on achieving greater effectiveness by finding out and grasping the forms and means that can attract the people, even if the contents of ideological education are on the same theme, and make the creation of new things a habitual trait.

It should not confine itself to conducting information and education work, but constantly improve it by making a scientific and quantitative analysis of how much it is effective and which means, forms and methods are most effective.

And efforts should be directed to the use of modern IT and other technical means in the direction of increasing the promptness and effectiveness of the information and education work and completely stopping the spread of reactionary ideology and culture.
Comrades,
The demand for innovation of ideological work boils down to the demand for the increasing of the awareness and capabilities of the officials in the information sector of the Party.

In order for our ideological work to raise the revolutionary spirit and revolutionary fighting morale of the masses and lead the times, information workers should be the first to have an extraordinary sense of responsibility and devotion.
As the information and education work is the work with the psychology of the people in all walks of life, even a lecture or motivation for increased production requires much effort.

The character of information workers, who can find the worth of making the revolution in doing difficult work without regarding it as trouble, is formed and consolidated just by an unusual sense of responsibility.

The mind of officials in the information sector should always be dominated by a sense of responsibility that if they fall back, their units, regions and sectors will collapse, and filled with the thinking and search as to how to improve the information work.

It is the responsible attitude of Party information workers to be able to feel the psychology of the masses even through a single word by them or a look of their eyes and promptly respond to the negative ideological elements with a keen sense as sharp as the blade of a knife touching the flesh.

They, whose life and blood can be said to be ideology, should fulfil their duty not only at work but also in their daily life. If they, who transmit the Party's ideas and policies, say this in front of the masses and act in a different way behind the scenes, it will foster distrust among the masses and cause the consequence of destroying the ideological position by themselves.

Officials in the information sector should not compromise with negative practices that are detrimental to the Party's ideology and the socialist principles, even if they may be struck by lightning or threatened with a dagger on their neck. In particular, they should never be involved in abuse of power, bureaucracy and accumulation of wealth by illicit means.
To decisively improve their level and abilities is a pressing task which has a direct bearing on the substantial innovation of the ideological work.

Recently it has been continually stressed that officials throughout the Party should acquire good writing and oratorical abilities, and these abilities are all the more vital and essential for information workers.

Party information workers should be fully versed in the Party's ideas and policies, ever prepared to influence the masses with the Party's intentions at any place and at any time and to give proper guidance and assistance to the work of primary information workers, and they should make steady efforts to improve their qualifications.
They should be all-round officials who are qualified politically and ideologically, well-versed in economic affairs and modern science and technology, and rich in cultural attainments and emotions.
Today, every field and unit needs talented personnel more than ever before, but the information sector demands that every worker be a talented person.

The information sector should take revolutionary measures to decisively improve the level of political and theoretical qualifications and practical abilities of its workers, and I think that it is natural that the endeavour to this end should begin in the Information and Publicity Department of the Party Central Committee.
It is natural that the department should plan and vigorously lead the innovative, creative and offensive ideological campaign required by the present era.

By forcefully pushing ahead with an all-out ideological campaign, it must restore its original features and resilience as the department which specializes in leading the Party's ideological work as a whole and conducting information and motivation work.

It should work out a scrupulous plan for innovating the Party-wide ideological work, adopt scientific, realistic and novel tactical measures, and make it its daily routine to strictly review information and motivation work on the basis of its efficiency and take relevant measures.
A change in the level and work style of its officials will bring about an improvement in the professional qualifications and work style of the information workers of the entire Party.

Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed the need to make every element of the ideological work an ideological and spiritual sustenance indispensable to everyone in the new era of transformation and a driving force of their genuine life and struggle, calling on all the participants to make their work run through with the principles, tactics and methods they acquired in the workshop, steadily learn and consolidate them through practice and constantly explore new keys to innovating the ideological work, thereby further enriching the wealth of the ideological work of the Party.
He continued:
Comrades,
Party information workers in all sectors and at all levels,
Ideology is, as has always been, fuel to the Korean revolution and the foremost resource for our state building.

It is a source of the greatest honour and special glory to live and work as an information worker of the Workers' Party of Korea which regards ideology as the first and foremost weapon and leads the revolution on its strength.

I am convinced that all the participants in the workshop will, by bravely shouldering their responsibility assigned by the times and revolution, play the vanguard role in dynamically writing textbooks for the ideological revolution which will be remembered in the history of our Party and handed down to posterity along with our era of transformation.
On this opportunity, I feel reassured to see your responsible attitude, overflowing vigour and pronounced confidence.

Greater successes and epochal achievements will continuously be etched on our journey for bringing earlier the attainment of our great ideals, a beautiful future, by dint of the invincible might of ideology.

Believing that all the participants and officials will open up the road of advance in the new era holding high the great banner of ideology-first principle and with enthusiasm and courage as befit ideological guards of the Workers' Party of Korea, I declare the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector close. -0-

a4c631990b9184f17ad35219cb832c4c.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Watches Football Match between Missile Administration and Second Economy Commission
paragraphs: Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- There took place a football game between the DPRK Missile Administration and the Second Economy Commission on September 22.
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, watched the game.

All the participants were filled with great excitement and joy to hold a significant sports and cultural event in the presence of Comrade Kim Jong Un at a time when they swell with the pride of having received thanks, as a token of deep trust, from the Party and the government for the precious successes they have achieved in implementing the Party's line on building up the national defences through defence science research and production.

Comrade Kim Jong Un met with leading officials in the munitions industry and extended warm congratulations and encouragement to the national defence scientific research group of the Missile Administration, the Second Economy Commission and all the munitions industrial workers who have devoted themselves to faithfully upholding the self-reliant defence policy of the WPK with practical successes.
He said today's sports game is to appreciate their efforts and express thanks to them.
Among the spectators were Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK.
The football match was held between Hwasong team of the Missile Administration and Ponghwa team of the Second Economy Commission.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed his thanks to the group of defence scientists and technicians and the munitions industrial workers for the contributions they have made by performing an unprecedented miracle, to be specially recorded in the history of sacred struggle for modernizing the DPRK's armed forces and bolstering the war-fighting capability, and clearly proving the matchless development and absolute superiority of our defence capability. He said that their patriotism and loyalty and devoted efforts constitute a priceless contribution, the most invaluable one never to be bartered for anything, in terms of the security, eternal development and prosperity of the country.

He called on the defence scientists and technicians and the munitions industrial workers to further redouble their revolutionary optimism and high spirit and continuously bring about a series of leaps forward and innovations in augmenting the national defence capability by their concerted efforts and thus defend the DPRK's inviolable sovereignty and security, safeguard peace and reliably guarantee the eternal development of the socialist motherland with the absolute superiority of strength.
The two teams, greatly honoured to play the match in front of Comrade Kim Jong Un, fiercely contended for the glory of their units. Hwasong team beat its rival 4:1.
A prize-awarding ceremony was held amid the enthusiastic applause of the spectators.

All the participants, who were honoured to have Comrade Kim Jong Un's great trust and encouragement, made a pledge of loyalty to stay more faithful to the important historic mission and duty they have assumed before the Party and the revolution, the country and its people, and consolidate the national defence capability to be most powerful. -0-
